"""Reopen portable evidence and prove the active runtime was restored exactly."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import tarfile
import decimal_common as c

index_path = c.ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-adaptive-decimal-2026-10-07.json'
index = c.read(index_path)
archive = c.ROOT/index['archive']
assert c.sha(archive) == index['archive_sha256'] and archive.stat().st_size == index['archive_bytes']
payloads = {}
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:xz') as tar:
    for member in tar:
        assert member.isfile() and not member.name.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(member.name).parts
        raw = tar.extractfile(member).read()
        if member.name == 'manifest.json':
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == index['manifest_sha256']
            manifest = json.loads(raw)
        else:
            digest = member.name.removeprefix('files/')
            assert member.name == 'files/'+digest and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == digest
            assert digest not in payloads
            payloads[digest] = raw
assert len(payloads) == index['unique_payload_count']
assert len(manifest['paths']) == index['source_path_count']
assert set(payloads) == {item['sha256'] for item in manifest['paths'].values()}
for item in manifest['paths'].values():
    assert item['member'] == 'files/'+item['sha256']
    assert len(payloads[item['sha256']]) == item['bytes']


def data(name):
    return payloads[manifest['paths']['$EXPERIMENT/'+name]['sha256']]


def value(name):
    return json.loads(data(name))


freeze = value('decimal-screen-freeze-1.json')
summary = value('screen-1/summary.json')
decision = value('decimal-screen-analysis-1.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(data('decimal-screen-freeze-1.json')).hexdigest() == index['freeze_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(data('screen-1/summary.json')).hexdigest() == index['summary_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(data('decimal-screen-analysis-1.json')).hexdigest() == index['analysis_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(data('finalize_decimal_drop.py')).hexdigest() == index['packet_driver_sha256']
assert len(summary['records']) == 240 and decision['timed_complete_calls'] == 1200
by_key = {(r['cell'],r['round'],r['role']):r for r in summary['records']}
assert len(by_key) == 240
for cell,cell_result in decision['cells'].items():
    ratios = []
    for round_number in range(1,16):
        control = by_key[(cell,round_number,'control')]
        candidate = by_key[(cell,round_number,'candidate')]
        for record in (control,candidate):
            assert not record['failed'] and not record['postcheck_errors']
            native = record['native']
            assert len(native['complete_calls_nanos']) == 5
            assert native['per_call_sha256'] == [freeze['fixtures'][cell]['result_sha256']]*5
            for artifact in list(record['artifacts'].values())+[record['receipt_artifact']]:
                relative = str(Path(artifact['path']).relative_to(c.OUT))
                assert hashlib.sha256(data(relative)).hexdigest() == artifact['sha256']
        ratios.append(sum(candidate['native']['complete_calls_nanos'])/sum(control['native']['complete_calls_nanos']))
    assert statistics.median(ratios) == cell_result['median_paired_ratio'] == index['cells'][cell]['median_paired_ratio']
assert index['status'] == 'dropped_below_frozen_complete_operation_gate'
assert not index['retained'] and not index['confirmation_run']
assert not index['gates']['primary_score_at_most_0_97']
assert not index['gates']['at_least_two_primary_cells_improve_three_percent']
initial = value('decimal-control-freeze-1.json')
for attempt in (1,2):
    snapshot = value(f'decimal-source-{attempt}.json')
    assert len(snapshot['candidate_source_hashes']) == 943
    for name,digest in snapshot['candidate_source_hashes'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(data(f'decimal-source-files-{attempt}/{name}')).hexdigest() == digest
for cell,fixture in freeze['fixtures'].items():
    relative = str(Path(fixture['oracle']).relative_to(c.OUT))
    assert hashlib.sha256(data(relative)).hexdigest() == fixture['oracle_sha256']
    assert len(json.loads(data(relative))) == fixture['result_rows']
assert len(value('components-1/summary.json')['records']) == 5
assert len(value('fixture-validation-2/summary.json')['records']) == 24

current = c.source_hashes()
assert current == initial['source_hashes'] and len(current) == 941
accepted_identity = c.digest(json.dumps(current,sort_keys=True).encode())
assert accepted_identity == index['accepted_source_identity_sha256']
assert not (c.ROOT/c.HARNESS).exists() and not (c.ROOT/c.COST).exists()
for name in (c.MODULE,c.PARENT):
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT/name) == initial['source_hashes'][name]
guard = c.read(c.OUT/'decimal-finalize-drop-guard-1.json')
assert guard['status'] == 'passed' and guard['process_group_drained'] and guard['direct_child_reaped']
assert c.sha(c.OUT/'decimal-finalize-drop-guard-1.log') == guard['log_sha256']
proof = {'schema_version':'shardloom.adaptive_decimal_restoration.v1','status':'verified',
    'restored_source_assets':len(current),'restored_source_identity_sha256':accepted_identity,
    'accepted_identity_serialization':'Python json.dumps(source_hashes, sort_keys=True), default separators',
    'compact_source_identity_sha256':c.identity(current),
    'accepted_runtime':initial['accepted_runtime'],'source_commit':c.git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
    'existing_files_restored':{name:current[name] for name in (c.MODULE,c.PARENT)},
    'candidate_only_files_removed':[c.HARNESS,c.COST],
    'decision_index_sha256':c.sha(index_path),'archive_sha256':c.sha(archive),
    'portable_unique_payloads_reopened':len(payloads),'portable_paths_verified':len(manifest['paths']),
    'complete_operation_processes_verified':240,'timed_complete_calls_verified':1200,
    'candidate_snapshots_verified':2,'candidate_snapshot_assets_each':943,
    'original_failures_retained':True,'native_jobs_run_for_restoration':False,
    'verifier_sha256':c.sha(Path(__file__)),
    'verifier_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'prior_verification_failure':{'receipt':c.read(c.OUT/'decimal-restoration-check-guard-1.json'),
        'log':(c.OUT/'decimal-restoration-check-guard-1.log').read_text(),
        'correction':'All 941 per-file hashes already matched. Compare the historical aggregate digest using its original default JSON separators; the newer experiment helper uses compact separators. No engine source or measurements changed.'},
    'finalizer_guard_sha256':c.sha(c.OUT/'decimal-finalize-drop-guard-1.json'),
    'finalizer_guard':guard}
c.write(c.ROOT/index['source_restoration_proof'],proof)
c.write(c.OUT/'decimal-restoration-1.json',proof)
print(json.dumps({key:proof[key] for key in ('status','restored_source_assets','restored_source_identity_sha256',
    'portable_unique_payloads_reopened','portable_paths_verified','timed_complete_calls_verified')}),flush=True)
